items.title: What Is Deere (DE) Signaling With Strong Q3 Results And The Tenna Deal?
items.summary: Deere (NYSE:DE) reported strong fiscal Q3 results, with the Construction and Forestry segment a key driver of performance. The company raised its full year profit outlook following the Q3 release, signaling higher internal expectations for 2026 earnings. Deere agreed to acquire Tenna LLC to expand its construction technology capabilities and strengthen its equipment management offerings. items.title: AI Bets Send Industrials Soaring, But a Slowdow May Be Coming
